featured_reviews.name: Joseph Selvanayagam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely horrible experience at the Royal Enfield Motokraft Chembur service center. My Himalayan 411 was serviced here under the guidance of Suraj (Service Advisor) and Mehtab (Technician), and I genuinely regret trusting them.

They charged ₹1000 and see the bill its 500+gst but the total is made as 1000 which is just for “greasing the rear suspension,” but they didn’t even bother to open the bolt — they simply applied grease outside and called it done. I asked they said its for swingarm but swing arm was never opened or greased for name sake they did greased on outside bolt. I’ve attached pictures for proof. This is pure cheating. Even the grease was mine maxima waterproof grease
The same I did outside he charged me just ₹100 that too he opened the linkage

On top of that, they charged ₹590 for “fuel tank cleaning,” which only meant draining the petrol and checking for water and again putting it back on fuel tank — nothing was actually cleaned.

This place is nothing but a money trap. They don’t care about customers or their bikes — all they care about is squeezing out every rupee they can. As a bike enthusiast, it’s honestly painful to see such dishonest practices from an official Royal Enfield service center. Because of people like this, even genuine mechanics lose trust.

I would never ever suggest this place to any of my Himalayan group

featured_reviews.name: Onkar Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
A heartfelt thank you to Govinda and his entire team for the effortless support and exceptional service they consistently provide! They are always ready to guide, help, and offer the best possible solutions with genuine dedication and professionalism.

Because of their care and expertise, my RE Himalayan 411 runs smoothly and efficiently every time I hit the road. A special mention to their service expert, Arvind — truly one of the most experienced and talented professionals any service centre could have. He has guided me through many aspects of maintaining and understanding my motorcycle, and his knowledge and willingness to help truly stand out.

This is exactly what great after-sales service should feel like. In fact, they go above and beyond expectations, delivering not just service but real customer satisfaction and delight. Highly grateful for the amazing support!

featured_reviews.name: shijin chandran
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most disappointing service experiences I've had.

What was most frustrating wasn't the delay or issue itself, but the attitude of the staff. Customers were treated with little respect, and there seemed to be no sense of accountability or urgency. It felt as though customer concerns simply didn't matter.

Royal Enfield has built a strong brand over the years, but a brand's reputation can only go so far when the service experience falls short. No matter how good the product is, customers expect to be treated with dignity, professionalism, and respect.

This experience has left such a negative impression that I genuinely don't see myself considering another Royal Enfield purchase anytime soon.

I sincerely hope the management takes customer service more seriously, because loyalty is earned not only through great motorcycles but also through the way customers are treated after the purchase.
